paragraphs.text: Wyvern is an obsolete creature type that depicted flying reptiles with a bird-like gait and two legs, smaller than the four-legged Dragons but larger than Drakes .

Wyvern debuted as a creature type in Mirage for the card Cerulean Wyvern . It was later consolidated into the Drake subtype with the release of Sixth Edition . The change was only made on the Oracle as the original has never been reprinted.
Wyverns can theoretically be found on any plane though thus far have been only seen on Dominaria , the former plane of Rath , and Vryn .

Dominaria is home to the Cerulean Wyverns from Jamuraa . They have sky-blue scales that allow them to surprise their prey from above on cloudless days. Benalian lancers ride pug-nosed, oxen-sized wyverns. They are dark gray with yellow bellies, sharp, scaly faces, and long, scythe-edged wings.

Rath was home to several types of Wyvern. The Sabertooth Wyvern s were known for their exceptionally large canine teeth. The Flowstone Wyvern s were made of stone while the Silver Wyvern had metallic scales.
Vryn is home to the Thunderclap Wyvern s which are known for creating sounds of thunder serving as a warning of their arrival.
